北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，注意保暖和补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has haze. Remember your mask, stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感舒适，户外活动别忘了防晒！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and pleasant. Don't forget sunscreen for outdoor fun!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海天气晴朗，微风舒适。注意昼夜温差，及时添减衣物。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny with a light breeze. Mind the day-night temperature difference!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云阴天，体感温暖。湿度稍高，记得保持室内通风。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm. High humidity, so keep your space airy.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感宜人。早晚凉爽，出门带件薄外套备用哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and pleasant. Pack a light jacket for cooler mornings/evenings.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗微风，舒适宜人。湿度较低，记得多喝水滋润身体。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is clear with a gentle breeze. Low humidity, so remember to hydrate.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好，体感稍凉，风力 3级。记得添衣，注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear, but feels cool with a 3-level wind. Dress warm and mind the wind!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗舒适，微风和煦。适合外出散步，感受阳光哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and comfortable with a gentle breeze. Perfect for a walk!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴好，风力 3级。体感微凉，出门别忘了带件外套。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny with a 3-level wind. Feels a bit cool, so bring a jacket.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感舒适。湿度很低，记得多喝水，做好补湿哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and comfortable. Very low humidity, so hydrate well!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗宜人，微风送爽。正是享受户外的好时光。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and pleasant with a light breeze. Great time to enjoy outdoors.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，气温 10℃。体感较冷，风力 3级，记得穿暖哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and 10℃. Feels chilly with a 3-level wind, so dress warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，风力 4级。体感较冷，出门注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy with a 4-level wind. Feels cold, so dress warm against the wind.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，风力 4级，体感较凉。注意防风，多喝水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear with a 4-level wind, feels cool. Mind the wind and hydrate.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光明媚，体感舒适。紫外线强，别忘了做好防晒哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and pleasant. UV is strong, so remember your sunscreen!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，气温 11℃。体感较冷，风力 3级，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and 11℃. Feels cold with a 3-level wind, stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，气温 10℃。体感湿冷，记得多穿些，别着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and 10℃. Feels damp and cold, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.
